about: #132 in-game settings menu content (track B). One line per setting (restart: none / stage = next stage / game = after a game restart); edit here, then python tools/menu/gen_menu_schema.py (writes runtime/menu_schema.h, checks parity with the runtime keys).

sections.title: Quick setup
sections.note: The game starts as the original. Items tagged Experimental are new and may be janky - try them if you like.

items.label: Resolution
items.help: How sharp the picture is. Auto matches your window or screen.

items.label: Aspect ratio
items.help: Widescreen 16:9 shows more of the world at the sides. 4:3 is the original picture.

items.label: Real-time shadows
items.help: Real shadows cast by the world and characters. Its options are on the Lighting page.

items.label: Full screen
items.help: Fill the whole screen. You can also press F11 or Alt+Enter.

items.label: Frame rate
items.help: Pictures per second; the game speed stays the same. Unlimited can make sound stutter on slow PCs.

items.label: Show frame rate
items.help: Shows the frame rate in a corner of the screen.

items.label: Cutscene smoothness
items.help: Cutscenes were made for 60. "Same as the game" can make them judder above 60.

items.label: Field of view
items.help: How wide the camera sees. 100% is the original.

items.label: View distance
items.help: How far away the world is drawn. 100% is the original; more can lower the frame rate.

items.label: Object distance
items.help: How far away rings and decorations appear. 100% is the original; more can lower the frame rate.

items.label: Original game logic
items.help: Runs the game's own code exactly: speed-ups off, view and object distance back to 100%.

items.label: Glow
items.help: The game's soft glow around bright lights, fire and neon. Off: a sharper, flatter picture.

items.label: Glow strength
items.help: 100% is the glow as in the original game; 0% is no glow.

items.label: Glow smoothness
items.help: Smooth: the same glow without square blocks. Original: the game's own blocky glow.

items.label: HDR
items.help: Brighter highlights on an HDR screen. Turn on HDR in Windows first.

items.label: Paper white
items.help: How bright normal white things are, like menus and sky.

items.label: Peak brightness
items.help: Set this to your screen's brightest level.

items.label: Highlights
items.help: How much extra brightness lights, fire and the sun get.

items.label: Saturation
items.help: How strong the colours are. 100% is normal.

items.label: Vibrance
items.help: Boosts dull colours more than bright ones.

items.label: Contrast
items.help: The difference between dark and bright parts. 100% is normal.

items.label: Black level
items.help: Below 0 makes blacks deeper, above 0 lighter.

items.label: UI brightness
items.help: How bright the menus and HUD are.

items.label: Black bars when needed
items.help: Bars slide in when the game shows a 4:3-only scene, hiding the gaps and missing scenery at the sides.

items.label: Menu colours
items.help: This menu in dark or light colours.

sections.title: Textures
sections.note: Put your textures in textures\Custom next to the game. System page > Extract the game's textures fills textures\Original: copy a picture from there, edit it, keep its file name (with the [tex1_...] part) and put it in Custom.

items.label: Use my textures
items.help: Uses your pictures from the textures\Custom folder next to the game. Changes show while you play.

items.label: My textures folder
items.help: Empty means textures\Custom next to the game. You can pick another folder here.

items.label: Match original colours
items.help: Moves your textures' colours closer to the original ones. 0% leaves them as they are.

items.label: L puts the camera behind you
items.help: Press L to swing the camera back behind Shadow.

items.label: Camera speed
items.help: How fast the camera turns.

items.label: Flip camera left / right
items.help: Turns the camera the other way left and right.

items.label: Flip camera up / down
items.help: Turns the camera the other way up and down.

items.label: Character look
items.help: Play as one of the game's other models: 2P colours, Metal, Super, Evil or Sonic.

items.label: Skip any cutscene
items.help: Press START (Tab on a keyboard) in a story scene or movie to skip it, even the first time.

items.label: Objects per stage
items.help: Room for more objects in custom stages (Original holds 2,048). Needs Original game logic off.

items.label: Hard bosses
items.help: Bosses fight with new, harder attacks, unlike the original fights.

items.label: Movement style
items.help: Original is the game itself. Make your own: New preset from the sliders, name it, then choose it.

items.label: Speed ram
items.help: At top speed, enemies you run into get hit instead of you.

items.label: Homing attack aim
items.help: Original: the closest target. Smart: the target you point the stick at, enemies first.

sections.title: On the ground
sections.note: Used by your own movement presets (Custom).

items.label: Top speed
items.help: 100% is the original.

items.label: Speeding up
items.help: 100% is the original.

items.label: Turning
items.help: 100% is the original.

items.label: Slowing in the air
items.help: 100% is the original.

items.label: Steering in the air
items.help: 100% is the original.

items.label: Jump height
items.help: 100% is the original.

items.label: Gravity
items.help: 100% is the original.

items.label: Falling speed
items.help: 100% is the original.

items.label: Bounce height
items.help: After a homing attack. 100% is the original.

items.label: Bounce time
items.help: After a homing attack. 100% is the original.

items.label: Fall after the bounce
items.help: 100% is the original.

items.label: Overall volume
items.help: All sound at once. 100% is the original.

items.label: Music
items.help: Stage and menu music.

items.label: Sound effects
items.help: Jumps, rings, explosions.

items.label: Voices
items.help: Characters talking and radio calls.

items.label: Mute when in the background
items.help: No sound while the game window is not in front or is minimised.

sections.title: Stages
sections.note: Small helpers, all off by default. They work only with Display > View > Original game logic off.

items.label: Enemies left on the warp screen
items.help: Shows how many mission enemies are left near each checkpoint.

sections.title: Shadows
sections.note: Experimental: real-time shadows are still being worked on and may look wrong or slow the game.

items.label: Shadow quality
items.help: Higher gives smoother shadow edges but is slower.

items.label: Shadow sharpness
items.help: Higher gives sharper shadows.

items.label: Shadow distance
items.help: How far away shadows are drawn.

items.label: Character shadows
items.help: Shadow and the other characters cast a soft shadow on the ground.

sections.title: Colour
sections.note: Picture colour in normal and HDR. With every slider at its default the game looks exactly as it did.

items.label: Brightness
items.help: Makes the whole picture brighter or darker. 0 is the original.

items.label: Black level
items.help: Below 0 makes the darkest parts darker, above 0 lighter. 0 is the original.

items.label: White level
items.help: How bright the brightest parts are. 100% is the original.

items.label: Mid tones
items.help: Above 100% brightens the middle shades, below 100% darkens them.

items.label: Contrast
items.help: Above 100% makes darks darker and brights brighter.

items.label: Colour strength
items.help: 0% is black and white, 100% is the original, 200% is very colourful.

items.label: Vibrance
items.help: Livens up dull colours without overdoing strong ones. 0% is the original.

items.label: Red
items.help: How much red is in the picture. 100% is the original.

items.label: Green
items.help: How much green is in the picture. 100% is the original.

items.label: Blue
items.help: How much blue is in the picture. 100% is the original.

items.label: Ambient occlusion
items.help: Soft shading in corners where surfaces meet. Work in progress: not available yet.

items.label: Unlock every stage
items.help: For Select Mode, this session only. Your save is not changed.

sections.title: Lives and rings
sections.note: Cheats last until you restart the game. Autosave can still keep what you earn with them.

items.label: Lives never run out
items.help: Your lives stay at 9.

items.label: Rings never run out
items.help: A hit still drops rings, but your count stays.

items.label: Never below 20 rings
items.help: You can still collect more.

items.label: 999 rings
items.help: Careful: this finishes Circus Park's ring mission at once.

items.label: Weapons never run out
items.help: Guns and weapons keep their ammo.

items.label: Every weapon in the weapon box
items.help: The special weapon box holds every weapon.

items.label: Vehicles never break
items.help: Vehicles and other health bars stay full.

items.label: Top score
items.help: Score set to 99,999,999.

items.label: Top Hero points
items.help: Hero points set to the maximum.

items.label: Top Dark points
items.help: Dark points set to the maximum.

items.label: Hero gauge always full
items.help: The Hero gauge never empties.

items.label: Dark gauge always full
items.help: The Dark gauge never empties.

items.label: Fill Hero gauge with Z + L
items.help: Hold Z and L to fill the Hero gauge.

items.label: Fill Dark gauge with Z + R
items.help: Hold Z and R to fill the Dark gauge.

items.label: Rings
items.help: Change your rings now.

items.label: Lives
items.help: Change your lives now.

items.label: Score
items.help: Change the score now.

items.label: Hero points
items.help: Change your Hero points now.

items.label: Dark points
items.help: Change your Dark points now.

items.label: Hero gauge
items.help: Fill the Hero gauge now: 0 to 100%.

items.label: Dark gauge
items.help: Fill the Dark gauge now: 0 to 100%.

items.label: Bug report key
items.help: F12, or Back + Start on a pad, saves a bug report (picture and game state) in the bugs folder.
